title: Monsoon flooding submerges access road to Government High School
description: The low-lying access culvert gets submerged in 3 feet of rainwater every time it rains, preventing 350 rural school children from reaching classes for days.

photoAuthenticity.detectionDetails: Ground proof image verified. Geotagged with citizen's declared GPS coordinates.

title: Severe Fluoride Contamination in Village Borewells & RO Plant Malfunction
description: In Mohanpur village, 4 out of 5 communal borewells have high fluoride content (>2.8 mg/L) causing dental and skeletal fluorosis among children. The solar-powered community RO water filtration plant has been non-operational for 3 months due to membrane scaling and lack of spare filters.

photoAuthenticity.detectionDetails: Verified genuine ground capture. Exif sensor signature valid. No synthetic artifacts detected.

sanctionRemarks: Official pilot deployment sanctioned by District Collectorate with technical hub partnership.

title: Broken Bridge Culvert Disrupting Ambulance Access to Mandal Hospital
description: Heavy monsoon runoff eroded the foundation of the main masonry culvert bridge connecting 6 agricultural hamlets to the Taluk CHC Hospital. Ambulances and milk delivery tankers cannot cross, forcing a 28 km detour over unpaved mud tracks.

photoAuthenticity.detectionDetails: Real camera proof verified with GPS geotag.

resolutionProof.description: Reinforced precast concrete culvert bridge installed and load-tested. Two-way all-weather vehicular and ambulance access restored to all 6 hamlets.
resolutionProof.resolvedBy: SetuBandhan Infrastructure Team (NIT Durgapur) & Kundgol PWD Sub-Division

title: Vaccine Cold-Chain Failure at Remote Primary Health Centre Due to Grid Outages
description: The Primary Health Sub-Centre suffers 14-hour daily rolling blackouts. Solar backup inverters suffered battery degradation, jeopardizing storage of essential neonatal vaccines (BCG, Rotavirus, Measles) and antivenom vials in the ILR (Ice Lined Refrigerator).

photoAuthenticity.detectionDetails: Ground shot validated with digital metadata.

title: Groundwater Depletion & Heavy Siltation in Minor Irrigation Canal
description: The tail-end distributary canal is choked with 2.5 meters of silt and plastic debris. Over 400 acres of paddy and groundnut fields have had zero water supply for two sowing cycles, forcing small farmers to spend heavily on erratic diesel pump rentals.

resolutionProof.description: Desiltation of 4.2 km minor irrigation canal completed using hydraulic excavators and community Shramdaan. Water flow restored to 400 acres.
resolutionProof.resolvedBy: Pusad Mandal Irrigation Taskforce & Team AgriJal

title: Restoration of Solar Fluoride Filtration Plant in Primary School
description: Fluoride contamination in school borewell water reached dangerous levels (3.1 ppm). Children were exhibiting early dental fluorosis symptoms.

resolutionProof.description: Commissioned 500 LPH indigenous solar-powered activated alumina nano-filter with automated backwash. Fluoride reduced from 3.1 ppm to 0.4 ppm (safe limit). Verified by District Jal Jeevan Testing Lab.
resolutionProof.resolvedBy: Jal-Drishti Innovators (IIT Roorkee Hub) & PHED Nagaur

title: Desilting and Sinking Slab Cover on Choked Town Commercial Drain
description: Open stormwater drain choked with plastic sludge causing backflow into market shops and street vendors.

resolutionProof.description: Heavy mechanical silt suction deployed. 180 meters of blocked masonry drain desilted, concrete grating slabs placed, and disinfectant sprayed.
resolutionProof.resolvedBy: Greater Warangal Municipal Corporation (GWMC) Ward 12 Sanitation Desk
